research.title: Broad equity exposure
research.summary: A diversified global equity fund. Past performance does not predict future returns.

research.title: Concentration check
research.summary: The five largest positions make up about a fifth of the fund. This is a description, not a recommendation.

research.title: Interest rate sensitivity
research.summary: Bond prices usually fall when interest rates rise. Duration shows how strongly.

research.title: Currency effect
research.summary: Values are converted from AED. Exchange-rate moves change the value in your portfolio currency.

research.title: Valuation and volatility
research.summary: Technology funds can move sharply in both directions. Scenarios are illustrations, not forecasts.

research.title: Local market
research.summary: Returns depend on the local market and on the KES exchange rate.

research.title: High volatility
research.summary: This asset has historically had very large price swings. It can lose value quickly.

research.title: Income focus
research.summary: Dividends are not guaranteed and can be reduced or stopped.

research.title: Currency and rate risk
research.summary: Government bond prices move with interest rates, and the value changes with the KES exchange rate.

research.title: Property exposure
research.summary: Property funds are less liquid than shares and can be hard to sell in a downturn.
